op.description: ls = list, rm = delete lines, summarize = replace lines with one message you write, set = replace one line

range.description: ls, rm, summarize: which lines, like "4", "2-5" or "6-" (6 to the end); ls without it lists all

text.description: summarize: your summary; the one message that replaces the range reads "aos: summary (lines A-B, N messages): TEXT"

message.description: set: the whole new message, like {"role": "user", "content": "hi"}

json.description: ls: true = one JSON array of {line, message} instead of text lines

keep.description: rm, summarize, set: keep the removed messages in this file instead of the default one (relative paths start at your workspace)

no_keep.description: rm, summarize, set: true = do not keep the removed messages anywhere
